reports.title: LegalZoom Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

guidance.heading: Financial Guidance and Outlook
section: For the full year ending December 31, 2026, LegalZoom is reiterating the midpoint of its revenue outlook and updating its Adjusted EBITDA outlook as follows:

•Revenue is expected to be in the range of $797 million to $803 million, or 6% year-over-year growth at the midpoint. This compares to the Company’s previous outlook in the range of $795 million to $805 million, also approximately 6% growth at the midpoint. LegalZoom’s outlook continues to reflect the
scaling of its higher-value growth initiatives and ongoing momentum from its partner channel, partially offset by continued pressure in customer acquisition for the remainder of the year.

•Adjusted EBITDA is expected to be in the range of $180 million to $185 million, or approximately 6% year-over-year growth and a 23% margin at the midpoint. This compares to the Company’s previous Adjusted EBITDA outlook of $190 million to $195 million, or 12% year-over-year growth, and a 24% margin at the midpoint. Compared to the previous outlook, more than half of the change reflects continued investment in channel diversification, including partnerships, affiliates and AI channels, approximately one quarter reflects higher costs in paid customer acquisition channels, and the remainder reflects investment in higher-value expert services, as well as seasonal investment in sales capabilities ahead of the first quarter peak in business formations.
For the fourth quarter ending December 31, 2026 LegalZoom expects:
•Revenue in the range of $190 million to $196 million, or 1% year-over-year growth at the midpoint.
•Adjusted EBITDA in the range of $48 million to $53 million, a 1% year-over-year growth at the midpoint, and a 26% margin.
